newsitem.title: USA: Spiegel's Eddie Bauer unit sales down.
newsitem.headline: Spiegel's Eddie Bauer unit sales down.

text.p: Spiegel Inc said Thursday that same-store sales for its Eddie Bauer unit decreased eight percent for the four-week period ended November 23.

November sales excluded the Thanksgiving holiday week, which hurt same-store sales. December's comparable store sales will reflect the favorable impact from the calendar shift due to the later than normal Thanksgiving holiday, it added.
For the 47-week period ended November 23, same-store sales for Eddie Bauer fell one percent.
The company said that a nine-percent comparable-store increase would have been realized this November if the four-week periods in both years had ended on the Saturday after Thanksgiving.
Spiegel said total sales for the four weeks ended November 23 were $288.0 milliion, down from $300.1 million a year ago.
For the 47-week period, total sales were $2.33 billion, down from $2.38 billion.
